preconditions.description: Both input strings must have at least one character.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' or all(c in seq1 and c in seq2 for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must be a common subsequence of both input strings.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == max(len(s) for s in [stdout] + [lcs(seq1, seq2) for _ in range(1)])
postconditions.description: The output must be the longest common subsequence.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' if not any(c in seq1 and c in seq2 for c in seq1) else True
postconditions.description: If there is no common subsequence, the output must be an empty string.
